1.name: One Death Save
1.description:
- The player can immediately take dash and disengage as extra actions.
 - The player can give themself a +5 bonus to any d20 test they just failed.
 - The player can reroll a failed d20 attack roll.

1.name: Two Death Save
1.description: - If an attack roll hits, each damage die deals maximum damage.

1.name: Three Death Save
1.description:
- The player can immediately take the Attack or Magic action as an extra action.
 - The player immediately regains an expended spell slot of Level 1 through 5.

1.name: WHile Unconscious
1.description: Every round, a character can choose to give another character within sight Heroic Inspiration, or alternatively, if they have no death save failures, they can choose to stabilize themselves.
